name: sol-luna-deepseek-router
description: Sol-led routing to native Luna and an isolated native DeepSeek child role, with explicit DSH compatibility, per-chat ownership, and writer leases.

interface.displayName: Sol 主控 · 原生 Luna/DeepSeek 峰谷分工
interface.shortDescription: Keep Sol in charge; route new work to native Luna or native DeepSeek by peak/valley schedule.
interface.longDescription: Keeps Sol and the current conversation intact while routing new coding tasks to native Luna at DeepSeek peak windows or to an isolated native_deepseek child role at valley windows. The child role uses its own deepseek-native provider and model catalog; Sol and Luna retain their normal provider and live catalog. The older shared-root gateway and GPT relay remain historical compatibility only. DSH MCP tools and the read-only trace remain available as explicit legacy compatibility.
